item.title: Remaining slavery exhibits don't need to be reinstalled for now, court rules
item.description: Displays about slavery at the President's House​ in Old City were being restored nearly a month after they were removed by order of the Trump administration.

item.title: Some victims of California avalanche near Lake Tahoe identified by families
item.description: The identities of some of the victims of the deadly California avalanche near Lake Tahoe became known on Thursday.

item.title: Trump admin. fires top prosecutor in Eastern Virginia shortly after he was hired by judges
item.description: The Trump administration fired an interim top prosecutor in Eastern Virginia almost immediately after he was hired by a panel of judges, deepening the conflict between the DOJ and the judiciary in that region.

item.title: 10/20/2024: Relief, N.C.; Navalny; The Swingiest County; The Cap Arcona
item.description: First, a look at Helene recovery efforts in North Carolina. Then, Yulia Navalnaya: The 60 Minutes Interview. Next, a look inside a battleground-state swing county. And, a report on the sinking of the Cap Arcona Nazi ship.

item.title: House Speaker denies request for Jesse Jackson to lie in honor at Capitol
item.description: House Speaker Mike Johnson's office has denied a request to have the late Rev. Jesse Jackson lie in honor in the U.S. Capitol Rotunda due to past precedent.

item.title: "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" guests for Feb. 22, 2026
item.description: This week's guests include Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde.

item.title: Judge who held DOJ lawyer in contempt blasts handling of immigration cases
item.description: A federal judge who took the extraordinary step of holding a government lawyer in contempt of court earlier this week blasted the Justice Department for its handling of immigration cases on Friday.

item.title: 2/20: The Takeout with Major Garrett
item.description: Supreme Court strikes down Trump's emergency tariffs; U.S. and Canada to face off for gold medal in men's hockey

item.title: 2/20: CBS Evening News
item.description: Trump lashes out at Supreme Court after justices strike down his tariffs; Man's cat sanctuary naps still helping rescue expand years after they first went viral

item.title: Trump imposes 10% tariffs on all countries after SCOTUS struck down earlier tariffs
item.description: President Trump signed an order that will impose 10% tariffs on imports from all countries, just hours after the Supreme Court struck down a different set of sweeping global tariffs.
